messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Pracuje w sklepie papierniczym w Opolu; posty pisze przed otwarciem albo wieczorem.
- zainteresowania: planery, wystawy sklepowe, rośliny balkonowe
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: przystanek Katowicka w Opolu
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Przestawia meble w kawalerce i szuka miejsca na kolejny regał.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: oszczędna, często bez kropek; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: rare
- tik językowy: często zaczyna od „dobra, więc”

For each of the 17 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. zdrowie i sen - dieta, postanowienia (late morning, Thursday)
2. pogoda - mgła rano (afternoon, Wednesday)
3. dzieci i rodzina - odbiór dziecka z przedszkola / szkoły (evening, Saturday)
4. sport - rower, trasa weekendowa (evening, Tuesday)
5. technologia i sprzęt - padła bateria / ładowarka (late morning, Friday)
6. zdrowie i sen - niewyspanie (late night, Friday)
7. praca i grafik - nowy projekt / nowe zadanie (lunch break, Wednesday)
8. zwierzęta - weterynarz, szczepienie (late night, Wednesday)
9. zdrowie i sen - ból pleców od siedzenia (morning commute, Tuesday)
10. sport - skoki narciarskie / siatkówka / żużel w TV (late morning, Sunday)
11. zdrowie i sen - kawa i sen, ironicznie (early morning, Tuesday)
12. praca i grafik - przerwa, kawa, stołówka (late morning, Wednesday)
13. jedzenie i gotowanie - zamówienie jedzenia z dowozem (early morning, Wednesday)
14. zwierzęta - spacer z psem (lunch break, Tuesday)
15. drobne narzekanie na usługi - przychodnia, rejestracja telefoniczna (late morning, Saturday)
16. zdrowie i sen - dentysta (late morning, Thursday)
17. komunikacja i dojazdy - kontrola biletów (lunch break, Sunday)

Return a JSON array of 17 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
